description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and its nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version details within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registering notifications, updating system info, and parsing version strings.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents network-related information such as public IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Provides security-related information, specifically the callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location details including timezone, country, region, and city.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Encapsulates device identification details such as identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the notification update method for each registered client.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: SystemInfo::Time::TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the system time synchronization value.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the build tree.
